brief: Inspect the unit and address outstanding defects in descending order of priority, focusing particularly on any oil level issues or active leaks which rank above oil condition defects before a heat event [SOP-016]. Ensure all vegetation and obstructions around radiator banks are cleared as clearance work takes precedence where a defect is outstanding [SOP-011]. For insulation ageing and end-of-life indicators, the supplied documents do not cover specific remedial actions for the cited oil issue beyond noting age and general indicators [MG-023].
